name: crawlio-browser-guide
description: Local MCP eyes for Crawlio Browser Guide: lets Claude Code and Codex read the page snapshot the user chose to share. Read-only by construction.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "import('./src/host-install.js').then(({isMachO, sha256, vendorMetadata}) => { const path = new URL('./vendor/macos/com.crawlio.browser_guide', import.meta.url).pathname; const meta = vendorMetadata(); if (!isMachO(path)) throw new Error('vendor host binary missing or invalid — run node ../scripts/package-mcp-host.mjs'); if (!meta || sha256(path) !== meta.sha256) throw new Error('vendor metadata is stale — rerun node ../scripts/package-mcp-host.mjs'); })"
